verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Agentforce agents working across Sales Cloud tasks such as qualifying leads, updating opportunities and closing renewals, and running autonomously on repetitive work. An official MCP server lets external AI agents drive the platform. However, the only explicit natural-language claim concerns building agents in Agent Builder, not reps issuing plain-language commands to operate the CRM, and it rests on vendor marketing alone. Missing for 10: documented conversational/natural-language command interface for end users inside Sales Cloud, specifics on which CRM actions can be executed via natural language, independent or hands-on corroboration.
